observations: Nikon DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' logo on the top plate.
Attached lens with 'Nikon' branding on the barrel.
The lens is currently fitted with a front cap.
The camera is being held by a person's hand.
A watermark 'STARSHOT IMAGE' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The model name is not visible in the photo.
The focal length markings are not legible in the photo.
The interior of the lens and the sensor are not shown.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not power on or the shutter may be near failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal fungus or scratches on the glass.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the front and rear lens elements without the cap.

risks.risk: The sensor may be scratched or have significant dust.
risks.proof: A photo of the sensor with the lens removed.

risks.risk: The shutter count may be very high, indicating the camera is near the end of its life.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent image file.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high shutter count

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the model name and serial number on the camera body.
Photo of the lens markings showing the focal length (e.g., 24-70mm).
Photo of the camera sensor with the lens removed.
Photo of the lens glass without the front cap.
Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
